官方文档可在 [Marlin 主页](https://marlinfw.org/)找到。 请测试此固件，如果有任何异常请告诉我们。志愿者随时准备提供帮助！ --- ## Marlin 2.1 错误修复分支 **不适用于生产用途。请谨慎使用！** Marlin 2.1 同时支持 32 位 ARM 和 8 位 AVR 开发板，并增加对最多 9 个协调轴和最多 8 个挤出机的支持。 此分支用于最新 2.1.x 发布版本的补丁，并会定期成为下一个 2.1.x 次版本的基础。 可在[发布页面](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/releases)下载早期版本。 ## 示例配置 为你的机器构建 Marlin 之前，需要适用于具体硬件的配置。应要求，供应商会提供机器的完整源代码和配置；但如果想安装较新版本的 Marlin，需要获取更新的配置文件。Marlin 用户贡献了数百种经过测试的配置供你入门。请访问 [MarlinFirmware/Configurations](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Configurations) 仓库查找适合你的硬件的配置，并确保选择兼容分支！[Marlin 下载页面](https://marlinfw.org/meta/download/)提供相互兼容的软件和配置包。 ## 构建 Marlin 2.1 构建和上传 Marlin 时可使用以下工具之一： - 免费的 [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/download)，配合 [Auto Build Marlin](https://marlinfw.org/docs/basics/auto_build_marlin.html) 扩展。 - Marlin 针对 Visual Studio Code 的 [PlatformIO IDE](https://platformio.org/) 扩展进行了构建优化。 - 也可以将 VSCode 与 devcontainer 一起使用：参阅[安装 Marlin（VSCode devcontainer）](https://marlinfw.org/docs/basics/install_devcontainer_vscode.html)。 - 仍可以使用 [Arduino IDE](https://www.arduino.cc/en/main/software) 构建 Marlin：参阅[使用 Arduino 构建 Marlin](https://marlinfw.org/docs/basics/install_arduino.html)。我们希望改进 Arduino 构建体验，但目前首选 PlatformIO。 ## 32 位 ARM 开发板 Marlin 兼容大量 32 位 ARM 开发板，它们提供充足的计算能力和内存，使 Marlin 能为现代 3D 打印机提供先进性能和功能。Marlin 的一些较新功能需要使用 32 位 ARM 开发板。 ## 8 位 AVR 开发板 Marlin 起源于基于 Arduino 的 8 位开发板时代，我们希望永久支持 8 位 AVR 开发板。32 位和 8 位开发板由同一个适用于所有机器的代码库支持。我们的目标是支持普通爱好者、动手玩家以及旧机器和旧开发板的拥有者，让他们与拥有更新、更高端设备的人一样受益于社区创新。此外，这些老牌 AVR 机器通常也最适合测试和反馈！ ## 硬件抽象层（HAL） Marlin 的硬件抽象层为所有目标平台提供通用 API，使 Marlin 代码可以无系统开销地处理最低层和最高层的运动及用户界面任务，并将所有事件直接绑定到硬件时钟。 每个新的 HAL 都会带来新的硬件选择。Marlin 当前拥有十多个平台的 HAL。AVR 和 STM32 最为知名和流行，ESP32、LPC1768 等也支持多种较少见的开发板。目前 RP2040 的 HAL 处于 beta 阶段；我们希望为 Duet3D 系列开发板增加 HAL。封装 RTOS 的 HAL 是一个值得探索的有趣概念。 你知道 Marlin 包含可在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 上运行的模拟器吗？加入 Discord，帮助推动这些子项目！ ### 支持的平台 | 平台 | MCU | 示例开发板 | | --- ## 其他 Marlin 支持 问题队列专用于错误报告和功能请求。配置与故障排查帮助请使用以下资源： - [Marlin 文档](https://marlinfw.org) - 官方 Marlin 文档 - [“Marlin Firmware”](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1049718498464482/) Facebook 群组 - RepRap.org 上的 [Marlin 论坛](https://forums.reprap.org/list.php?415) - [“Marlin Firmware for 3D Printers”](https://www.facebook.com/groups/3Dtechtalk/) Facebook 群组 - YouTube 上的 [Marlin 配置](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=marlin+configuration)播放列表 ## 贡献补丁 请向 [bugfix-2.1.x](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/tree/bugfix-2.1.x) 分支提交 Pull Request，贡献你的补丁。 - 我们使用 `bugfix-2.1.x` 分支修复错误，并将新功能集成到最新固件中。请谨慎使用！ - 我们维护 `lts-x.x.x` 分支，主要供供应商使用，以便按需为旧版 Marlin 打补丁，保持其功能并修复错误。 - 遵循[代码规范](https://marlinfw.org/docs/development/coding_standards.html)有助于获得维护者认可。 - 请向[问题队列](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/issues/new/choose)提交功能请求和错误报告。用户支持请见上文。 - 添加新功能时，务必向 `buildroot/tests` 添加一个或多个构建测试。添加到 PR 的测试一经推送就会在 GitHub 服务器上运行。如有可能，请先在本地运行新测试，以减少迭代。 - 本地构建测试： - 全部：`make tests-config-all-local` - 单项：`make tests-config-single-local TEST_TARGET=...` - Docker 中的本地构建测试： - 全部：`make tests-config-all-local-docker` - 单项：`make tests-config-single-local-docker TEST_TARGET=...` - 运行所有单元测试套件： - 使用 PIO：`platformio run -t test-marlin` - 使用 Make：`make unit-test-all-local` - 使用 Docker + make：`make unit-test-all-local-docker` - 运行单个单元测试套件： - 使用 PIO：`platformio run -t marlin_` - 使用 make：`make unit-test-single-local TEST_TARGET=` - 使用 Docker + make：`make unit-test-single-local-docker TEST_TARGET=` - 如果功能可以进行单元测试，请添加一个或多个单元测试。更多信息参阅[单元测试](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/tree/6e03341e0436b076f8339f0f702be18a05f81522/test)文档。 ## 贡献者 来自世界各地的大量贡献者发挥各自专长和才能，使 Marlin 不断改进。非常感谢[所有贡献者](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/graphs/contributors)长期修复错误、帮助引导交流并维持 Marlin 运行。没有他们，Marlin 不可能持续存在。 Marlin Firmware 原始 Logo 由 Ahmet Cem TURAN [@ahmetcemturan](https://github.com/ahmetcemturan) 设计。 ## 项目领导团队 | 姓名 | 职责 | 链接 | 捐赠 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 🇺🇸 Scott Lahteine | 项目负责人 | [[@thinkyhead](https://github.com/thinkyhead)] | [❤️ 捐赠](https://marlinfw.org/docs/development/contributing.html#donate) | | 🇳🇿 Peter Ellens | 管理员 | [[@ellensp](https://github.com/ellensp)] | [❤️ 捐赠](https://ko-fi.com/ellensp) | | 🇬🇧 Chris Pepper | 管理员 | [[@p3p](https://github.com/p3p)] | | 🇺🇸 Keith Bennett | 管理员 | [[@thisiskeithb](https://github.com/thisiskeithb)] | [❤️ 捐赠](https://github.com/sponsors/thisiskeithb) | | 🇺🇸 Roxanne Neufeld | 管理员 | [[@Roxy-3D](https://github.com/Roxy-3D)] | | 🇺🇸 Jason Smith | 管理员 | [[@sjasonsmith](https://github.com/sjasonsmith)] | | 🇧🇷 Victor Oliveira | 管理员 | [[@rhapsodyv](https://github.com/rhapsodyv)] | | 🇺🇸 Bob Kuhn | 管理员 | [[@Bob-the-Kuhn](https://github.com/Bob-the-Kuhn)] | | 🇳🇱 Erik van der Zalm | 创始人 | [[@ErikZalm](https://github.com/ErikZalm)] | ## Star 历史 ## 许可证 Marlin 根据 [GPL 许可证](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/blob/6e03341e0436b076f8339f0f702be18a05f81522/LICENSE)发布，因为我们相信开放开发。GPL 同时赋予权利并规定义务。无论你在开源还是闭源产品中使用 Marlin 固件作为驱动，都必须保持 Marlin 开源，并应最终用户要求提供兼容的 Marlin 源代码。项目说明，遵守 Marlin 许可证最直接的方式是在 GitHub 上 fork Marlin、进行修改，并将用户引导到你修改后的 fork。

Official documentation can be found at the [Marlin Home Page](https://marlinfw.org/). Please test this firmware and let us know if it misbehaves in any way. Volunteers are standing by! --- ## Marlin 2.1 Bugfix Branch **Not for production use. Use with caution!** Marlin 2.1 supports both 32-bit ARM and 8-bit AVR boards while adding support for up to 9 coordinated axes and to up to 8 extruders. This branch is for patches to the latest 2.1.x release version. Periodically this branch will form the basis for the next minor 2.1.x release. Download earlier versions of Marlin on the [Releases page](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/releases). ## Example Configurations Before you can build Marlin for your machine you'll need a configuration for your specific hardware. Upon request, your vendor will be happy to provide you with the complete source code and configurations for your machine, but you'll need to get updated configuration files if you want to install a newer version of Marlin. Fortunately, Marlin users have contributed hundreds of tested configurations to get you started. Visit the [MarlinFirmware/Configurations](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Configurations) repository to find the right configuration for your hardware. Make sure to select a compatible branch! [The Marlin Download Page](https://marlinfw.org/meta/download/) matches compatible software and configuration packages. ## Building Marlin 2.1 To build and upload Marlin you will use one of these tools: - The free [Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/download) using the [Auto Build Marlin](https://marlinfw.org/docs/basics/auto_build_marlin.html) extension. - Marlin is optimized to build with the [PlatformIO IDE](https://platformio.org/) extension for Visual Studio Code. - You can also use VSCode with devcontainer : See [Installing Marlin (VSCode devcontainer)](https://marlinfw.org/docs/basics/install_devcontainer_vscode.html). - You can still build Marlin with [Arduino IDE](https://www.arduino.cc/en/main/software) : See [Building Marlin with Arduino](https://marlinfw.org/docs/basics/install_arduino.html). We hope to improve the Arduino build experience, but at this time, PlatformIO is the preferred choice. ## 32-bit ARM boards Marlin is compatible with a plethora of 32-bit ARM boards, which offer ample computational power and memory and allows Marlin to deliver state-of-the-art performance and features we like to see in modern 3d printers. Some of the newer features in Marlin will require use of a 32-bit ARM board. ## 8-Bit AVR Boards Marlin originates from the era of Arduino based 8-bit boards, and we aim to support 8-bit AVR boards in perpetuity. Both 32-bit and 8-bit boards are covered by a single code base that can apply to all machines. Our goal is to support casual hobbyists, tinkerers, and owners of older machines and boards, striving to allow them to benefit from the community's innovations just as much as those with fancier machines and newer boards. In addition, these venerable AVR-based machines are often the best for testing and feedback! ## Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) Marlin's Hardware Abstraction Layer provides a common API for all the platforms it targets. This allows Marlin code to address the details of motion and user interface tasks at the lowest and highest levels with no system overhead, tying all events directly to the hardware clock. Every new HAL opens up a world of hardware. Marlin currently has HALs for more than a dozen platforms. While AVR and STM32 are the most well known and popular ones, others like ESP32 and LPC1768 support a variety of less common boards. At this time, an HAL for RP2040 is available in beta; we would like to add one for the Duet3D family of boards. A HAL that wraps an RTOS is an interesting concept that could be explored. Did you know that Marlin includes a Simulator that can run on Windows, macOS, and Linux? ## Other Marlin Support The Issue Queue is reserved for Bug Reports and Feature Requests. Please use the following resources for help with configuration and troubleshooting: - [Marlin Documentation](https://marlinfw.org) - Official Marlin documentation - ["Marlin Firmware"](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1049718498464482/) Facebook Group - [Marlin Forum](https://forums.reprap.org/list.php?415) at RepRap.org - ["Marlin Firmware for 3D Printers"](https://www.facebook.com/groups/3Dtechtalk/) Facebook Group - [Marlin Configuration](https://www.youtube.com/results?search_query=marlin+configuration) playlist on YouTube ## Contributing Patches Contribute your patches to Marlin by submitting a Pull Request to the ([bugfix-2.1.x](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/tree/bugfix-2.1.x)) branch. - We use the `bugfix-2.1.x` branch to fix bugs and integrate new features into the latest firmware. Use with caution! - We maintain `lts-x.x.x` branches, mainly for vendors, so that older versions of Marlin can be patched as-needed to stay functional and fix bugs. - Follow the [Coding Standards](https://marlinfw.org/docs/development/coding_standards.html) to gain points with the maintainers. - Please submit Feature Requests and Bug Reports to the [Issue Queue](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/issues/new/choose). See above for user support. - Whenever you add new features, be sure to add one or more build tests to `buildroot/tests`. Any tests added to a PR will be run within that PR on GitHub servers as soon as they are pushed. To minimize iteration be sure to run your new tests locally, if possible. - Local build tests: - All: `make tests-config-all-local` - Single: `make tests-config-single-local TEST_TARGET=...` - Local build tests in Docker: - All: `make tests-config-all-local-docker` - Single: `make tests-config-all-local-docker TEST_TARGET=...` - To run all unit test suites: - Using PIO: `platformio run -t test-marlin` - Using Make: `make unit-test-all-local` - Using Docker + make: `make unit-test-all-local-docker` - To run a single unit test suite: - Using PIO: `platformio run -t marlin_` - Using make: `make unit-test-single-local TEST_TARGET=` - Using Docker + make: `make unit-test-single-local-docker TEST_TARGET=` - If your feature can be unit tested, add one or more unit tests. For more information see our documentation on [Unit Tests](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/tree/6e03341e0436b076f8339f0f702be18a05f81522/test). ## Contributors Marlin is constantly improving thanks to a huge number of contributors from all over the world bringing their specialties and talents. Huge thanks are due to [all the contributors](https://github.com/MarlinFirmware/Marlin/graphs/contributors) who regularly patch up bugs, help direct traffic, and basically keep Marlin from falling apart. Marlin's continued existence would not be possible without them.
